title: Read the small print.
text: Read the small print.. Read the small print.  Due to international shipping regulations the lighter does not come preloaded with butane.  This is understandable but should be featured more prominently in the description of the product.  The instructions are poorly translated from another language and by no means clear.

product_metadata.title: TOPKAY Torch Lighter, Candle Lighter, Multipurpose Windproof Jet Flame Butane Refillable Torch Lighter for Fire Starter, Grill, BBQ, Camping with a Gift Box (Empty Gas)
